headline: Profit and case volumes rise, fresh EPS growth target set
summary_short: Sysco's GAAP diluted EPS rose to $1.15 (+4.5% y/y) as sales grew 4.7% to $22.1B and operating income rose 10.6% to $983M; the company also introduced FY2027 guidance of 6%-7% sales growth and 9%-11% adjusted EPS growth.
summary_long: Fourth-quarter sales rose 4.7% to $22.1B on U.S. local-volume growth (+2.6%) and International local-volume growth (+4.5%), while gross margin slipped 17bp to 18.7% on meat/produce inflation, offset by Sysco Brand mix and sourcing efficiencies. Adjusted operating expenses grew slower than sales, lifting operating income 10.6% to $983M and adjusted diluted EPS 3.4% to $1.53 (GAAP diluted EPS $1.15, +4.5% y/y). For the full fiscal year, free cash flow rose 16.3% to $2.1B and the company returned $1.2B to shareholders via $200M of buybacks and $1.0B of dividends. Sysco introduced FY2027 guidance of 6%-7% sales growth and 9%-11% adjusted EPS growth on a 53-week basis, including ~$100M of AI-driven efficiency savings.

drivers.explanation: Quarter profit growth tracked 4.7% sales growth, positive U.S. local volume, and cost management, partly offset by $11 million of incremental incentive compensation (a $0.01 per-share drag) and higher acquisition-related and headcount costs.
